verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs describe forwarding user data to hundreds of vendors through an integrations directory. They also document per-output forwarding rules and consent filters for filtering, and a community user confirms events are forwarded to many downstream providers. Per-destination field mapping is evidenced only by a doc title about transforming data as it leaves mParticle. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of per-destination event/attribute mapping, concrete per-destination filtering configuration beyond privacy forwarding rules, and an evidenced catalog size or breadth of the integration directory.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can route events to a large catalog of documented destination integrations with per-destination mapping and filtering

citations.quote: simplifies how you collect and connect your user data to hundreds of vendors without needing to manage multiple integrations
Navigate to Data Platform > Setup > Directory, and click the card for your audience partner of choice.
Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
